subject.title: [bug]：Gateway pairing failure on Trim OS / TerraMaster NAS: WebSocket closes with code 1002 during device proof response

question: Should this be handled as a core Gateway protocol/diagnostics repair, a Trim OS package config-management follow-up, or held for live proof before any auth/pairing change?
rationale: The remaining fixes could alter Gateway device pairing or shared-auth behavior, and the reported package config regeneration is not present in this repository.

options.title: Collect proof before changing auth
options.body: Ask for redacted Gateway `connect` frame/logs, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing code or package changes.

options.title: Core diagnostic or CLI repair
options.body: If logs show an official current client sending an incompatible frame, fix Gateway/CLI diagnostics or compatibility without loosening pairing defaults.

options.title: Route package config ownership
options.body: If only the Trim OS app manager rewrites `gateway.auth`, keep core auth secure and route config persistence to the package owner.

recommendation.title: Collect proof before changing auth
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Gateway `connect` frame/logs, exact CLI/Gateway/package versions, and before/after generated config before choosing code or package changes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the broadest recent history across Gateway protocol compatibility, device pairing docs, and setup UX around this surface.
